nodes.name: browser.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright-backed browser session that keeps a persistent, logged-in Chromium profile so login-gated and JS-rendered hackathon pages can be fetched reliably. Playwright is lazy-loaded via dynamic import so the base install stays light, and the session degrades to null when the browser is unavailable.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses launchPersistentContext so one profile dir survives across runs and a human can sign in once; Playwright is imported dynamically so the Chromium download only matters when a URL actually needs the browser.

nodes.name: fetch.ts
nodes.summary: Escalation fetcher that funnels all web content retrieval through a single chain: plain fetch, then browser render, then a human-in-the-loop login/paste gate. Never throws — a failed fetch degrades to a 'failed' outcome so the caller records a gap.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AbortSignal.timeout for bounded requests and discriminates outcomes via a source union ('fetch' | 'browser' | 'pasted' | 'failed').

nodes.name: fetch.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit suite for fetchWithEscalation covering the full escalation chain: fast-path plain fetch, thin-content escalation to the browser, pasted-content handoff, retry after a human signs in, and fallback when the browser fails but plain fetch was usable.
nodes.languageNotes: Stubs the global fetch with vi.stubGlobal and uses a Partial<T> spread-overrides fixture pattern for EventConfig, BrowserSession, and ControlRoomServer.

nodes.name: createBrowserSession
nodes.summary: Lazily loads Playwright and launches a persistent Chromium context at profileDir, returning a BrowserSession whose render/openForLogin/close methods reuse a single logged-in profile. Returns null with an install hint when Playwright or Chromium is unavailable.

nodes.name: fetchWithTimeout
nodes.summary: Performs a plain HTTP GET with a research-bot User-Agent and an AbortSignal.timeout bound, returning the response body text or null on non-OK status or network error.

nodes.name: fetchWithEscalation
nodes.summary: Resolves a URL's content by escalating through plain fetch, browser render, and an interactive auth/paste gate, honoring useBrowser and minContentChars config. Returns a FetchOutcome and never throws, falling back to a 'failed' gap signal.

nodes.name: makeConfig
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal EventConfig test fixture with sensible defaults (slug, name, mode 'headless') overridable per test via Partial spread.
